speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given his age and the history of a growing, painless chest lesion, has this lesion changed recently in any way, such as becoming more asymmetrical or irregular in shape? Also, has he noticed any other new lumps or changes elsewhere on his body?

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Melanoma.
